bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/app.rs (frame drawing), springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs (frame timing), springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (Material blur), springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (image decode), springboard/ui/src/shader_effect.rs, springboard/ui/src/texture_loader.rs, springboard/ui/src/drawable_view.rs, springboard/ui/src/render_loop.rs, springboard/src/gpu/ (internal GLES presenter, not app-facing)
summary: GLKit is an OpenGL and OpenGL ES helper layer (GL view, view controller render loop, shader effects, mesh and texture loading, math). Apple marks most of it deprecated on macOS from 10.14, and macOS requires an OpenGL 3.2 Core Profile context. BifrOSt has no app-facing GL view or shader API; its GPU presenter is internal. Pure models in springboard/ui cover the effect, drawable, loop, texture-request and math parts, and apps get blur materials, a draw and animation loop and image decoding.

gaps: No app-facing GL view or drawable: apps cannot create an OpenGL or GLES context on BifrOSt (springboard/src/gpu/mod.rs is internal). The drawable_view model is not wired to a context.
No app-supplied shaders: the effect model in shader_effect.rs computes shading on the CPU and cannot run a custom GPU program.
No 3D math types beyond the pure models: matrix, vector and quaternion types are in springboard/ui/src/linalg.rs and are not re-exported through the SDK.
No mesh or 3D buffer API in the SDK; the buffer model in mesh.rs does not touch GPU memory.
No GPU texture upload for apps; texture_loader.rs models the requests and image decode is CPU-only (springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs).
Apple deprecated most of GLKit on macOS from 10.14. Parity work here would target the Metal-equivalent path rather than GLKit, so this framework may stay a documented n/a for new apps.
